Question 5
?

Construct the vector field that has the stream function ψ(x,y)=x3−3xy2.

a
F(x,y)=(6x2+3xy)i−3x2yj
b
F(x,y)=(3x2−3y2)i+6xyj
c
F(x,y)=(3x2−3xy2)i−3x2yj
d
F(x,y)=−6xyi−(3x2−3y2)j
e
F(x,y)=−3x2i−(3x2y+3xy2)j
Submit
